const $=(sel)=>root_element.querySelector(sel);const $$=(sel)=>Array.from(root_element.querySelectorAll(sel));const esc=(v)=>frappe.utils.escape_html(v==null||v===''?'-':String(v));const iconEmoji={truck:'🚛',ship:'🚢',droplet:'🪣',users:'👥',clock:'⏱',calendar:'📅',box:'📦',check:'✅',dot:'●'};const route=(r)=>{if(Array.isArray(r))frappe.set_route(...r);};const listRoute={assign_vehicle:['List','Transport Schedule',{transport_status:'Pending Assignment'}],assign_driver:['List','Transport Schedule',{transport_status:'Vehicle Assigned'}],dispatch:['List','Transport Schedule',{transport_status:['in',['Scheduled','Vehicle Assigned','Driver Assigned']]}],today:['List','Transport Schedule',{scheduled_pickup_date:frappe.datetime.get_today()}],inward:['List','Transport Schedule',{transport_type:'Inward'}],outward:['List','Transport Schedule',{transport_type:'Outward'}],deadlines:['List','Transport Schedule',{gate_cutoff:['>=',frappe.datetime.get_today()]}],alerts:['List','Transport Schedule']};root_element.addEventListener('click',(ev)=>{const btn=ev.target.closest('[data-route]');if(btn)route(JSON.parse(btn.dataset.route));const list=ev.target.closest('[data-list]');if(list)route(listRoute[list.dataset.list]);});function badge(status){const s=status||'';let cls='badge-default';if(['Draft','Pending Assignment','Vehicle Assigned'].includes(s))cls='badge-pending';if(['Scheduled','Driver Assigned'].includes(s))cls='badge-scheduled';if(['Dispatched','Picked Up','Gate In','In Transit','Delivered','Completed'].includes(s))cls='badge-transit';return `${esc(s)}`;}function table(headers,rows,cells){if(!rows||!rows.length)return '
No records yet
';return `${headers.map(h=>``).join('')}${rows.map(r=>`${cells(r).join('')}`).join('')}
${esc(h)}
`;}function renderStatusChart(summary){const area=$('[data-status-chart]');if(!area)return;area.innerHTML='';const labels=summary.map(x=>x.label);const values=summary.map(x=>x.count||0);if(!values.some(v=>v>0)){area.innerHTML='
No data
';return;}new frappe.Chart(area,{title:'',data:{labels,datasets:[{values}]},type:'donut',height:280,colors:['#dc3545','#f59f00','#2275d7','#20c997','#6f42c1']});const statsLegend=area.querySelector('.graph-stats-container');if(statsLegend)statsLegend.remove();}function render(data){$('[data-td-date]').textContent=data.date||frappe.datetime.get_today();$('[data-td-actions]').innerHTML=(data.today_actions||[]).map(a=>`
${iconEmoji[a.icon]||iconEmoji.dot}
${esc(a.title)}
${esc(a.priority)}
${esc(a.action)} →
`).join('');$$('[data-action-route]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click',()=>route(JSON.parse(el.dataset.actionRoute))));const k=data.kpis||{};const kpis=[['Inward Requests Pending',k.inward_pending],['Outward Export Containers',k.export_containers],['Local Deliveries - Tankers',k.tankers],['Local Deliveries - Trailers',k.trailers],['Vehicles To Dispatch Today',k.dispatch_today],['Completed Today',k.completed_today],['Pending Driver Assignment',k.driver_pending],['Pending Vehicle Assignment',k.vehicle_pending],['In Transit',k.in_transit],['PO Requests Pending Payables',k.payables_pending],['Security Draft DNs Pending',k.security_pending],['Gate Out Pending',k.gate_out_pending]];$('[data-td-kpis]').innerHTML=kpis.map(x=>`
${esc(x[0])}
${x[1]||0}
`).join('');$('[data-table="inward"]').innerHTML=table(['Material Pickup','Supplier / Source','Vehicle Type','Driver','ETA','Status','Action'],data.inward,r=>[`${esc(r.material_description||r.name)}`,`${esc(r.supplier)}`,`${esc(r.vehicle_type)}`,`${esc(r.assigned_driver_name||r.assigned_driver)}`,`${esc(r.scheduled_delivery_date)}`,`${badge(r.transport_status)}`,`View`]);$('[data-table="export"]').innerHTML=table(['Job Order Number','Product Name','No. of Containers','Container Type','Port / Destination','SI/LL Cutoff','Pull Out','Gate In','Gate Cutoff','Assigned Vehicle','Status','Action'],data.export,r=>[`${esc(r.job_order_number||r.job_order||r.name)}`,`${esc(r.material_description)}`,`${esc(r.container_count)}`,`${esc(r.container_type)}`,`${esc(r.port_of_loading)} / ${esc(r.port_of_discharge)}`,`${esc(r.si_cutoff||r.cutoff_date)}`,`${esc(r.pull_out_date||r.scheduled_pickup_date)}`,`${esc(r.gate_in_date)}`,`${esc(r.gate_cutoff)}`,`${esc(r.assigned_vehicle)}`,`${badge(r.transport_status)}`,`Open`]);$('[data-table="local"]').innerHTML=table(['Customer / Destination','Job Order Number','Material','Vehicle','Driver','Delivery Slot','Status','Action'],data.local,r=>[`${esc(r.customer||r.delivery_location)}`,`${esc(r.job_order_number||r.job_order||r.name)}`,`${esc(r.material_description)}`,`${esc(r.assigned_vehicle)}`,`${esc(r.assigned_driver_name||r.assigned_driver)}`,`${esc(r.scheduled_pickup_date)} ${esc(r.pickup_time)}`,`${badge(r.transport_status)}`,`View`]);$('[data-list-area="deadlines"]').innerHTML=(data.deadlines||[]).length?data.deadlines.map(d=>`
Gate Cutoff - JO ${esc(d.job_order_number||'N/A')} • ${esc(d.shipping_booking||d.name)}
${esc(d.port_of_discharge)}
${esc(d.gate_cutoff)}
`).join(''):'
No upcoming deadlines
';$('[data-list-area="alerts"]').innerHTML=(data.alerts||[]).length?data.alerts.map(a=>`
${esc(a.message)}
${esc(a.age)}${a.job_order_numbers&&a.job_order_numbers.length?` • JO: ${esc(a.job_order_numbers.join(', '))}`:''}
`).join(''):'
No alerts
';const summary=data.status_summary||[];const total=summary.reduce((n,x)=>n+(x.count||0),0);$('[data-total]').textContent=total;$('[data-status-summary]').innerHTML=summary.map(x=>`
${esc(x.label)}${x.count||0}
`).join('');renderStatusChart(summary);}frappe.call({method:'apc_operations.shipping.api.get_transportation_dashboard_data',callback:r=>render(r.message||{}),error:()=>{$('.td-shell').innerHTML='
Unable to load Transportation Dashboard.
Check server logs for API errors.
';}});
